items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: I've known him for years, and we've been friends and admirers of each other.

ctx.x: No, No I didn't replace -- well, Jonah wasn't there. Let me see, I'm trying to think who -- who had been there? Okay, I guess it was Jonah. I can't think of another -- another --
But you came in more or less at the time that he left. He must have -- he joined Cab about '39, I think, '39, '40.
